description: Added `PublishWithFederatedManagedIdentityCredential` overloads so an Aspire-created Entra ID app registration trusts the managed identity of the workload using it, letting deployed apps authenticate without a client secret or certificate. `WithFederatedManagedIdentityCredential(clientId)` (renamed from `WithFicMsi`) covers existing registrations.
name: Federated managed identity credentials for Entra ID apps
